about: People (lib/people.ts and lib/permissions.ts run as they are; app/People.tsx's, UnlockPeople.tsx's, AddPerson.tsx's, ResetPassword.tsx's, RemovePerson.tsx's, usePeople.ts's and api/people.ts's own, read out of their source). A row's `person` is the server's shape; `now` is the epoch second its sign-in words are said at. `said`, `problem`, `warning` and `reason` are null where the web says nothing.

words.UNLOCKED_LINE: Unlocked on this device until it's left alone for 15 minutes. Lock ends it now.
words.HTTP_NOTE: This page isn't over HTTPS: a password typed here crosses your network readable, as everyone's sign-in does. That's fine on your own network or over a VPN; anywhere else, put HTTPS in front of deadwax first.
words.KNOWN_ONLY_LINE: People deadwax still keeps things for who no longer have a Navidrome account - deleted in Navidrome's own Users page, or a removal deadwax couldn't finish.

LINES.request: Search Soulseek and download - Get, Sources, Another source, Same source again.
LINES.edit: Tags, covers, CD art, lyrics, artist pictures, applying a release - one album or Library care's runs.
LINES.library: Delete albums, move an artist's albums, Needs a look, Rescan, In nobody's library.
LINES.downloads: See who asked for what, cancel or retry anyone's, clear everyone's finished.
LINES.server: The server settings and the event log.

words.WARN_SERVER: Settings can point deadwax at other folders and change how it downloads and files - give it only to someone you'd trust as an admin.
words.WARN_LIBRARY: This includes deleting albums from disk, which can't be undone.
words.WARN_NO_REQUEST: They can still play, look through and add what the collection has.
words.PEOPLE_ONLY: Only an admin can open People - it comes with being a Navidrome admin.
